data.narrative: Chose minimal_plus_links for OrderFlow so 3AM on-call has one entry-point runbook with copyable commands, and deep links for architecture/dashboards. Built a verify→diagnose→mitigate→escalate runbook, then broke a “clean” peer doc on fake helm rollback, wrong DB secret name, and missing worker/jq gaps, and patched those in place.
